stageLabels: 🌱 Starter · create the need to know
👩‍🏫 I Do 2 · connect the second idea
🎫 Exit ticket · response becomes the next step

sequence.title: Day and Night: Sky Shift
sequence.outcome: Explain day and night and the apparent movement of the Sun.
sequence.objective: I can explain that Earth's rotation causes day and night and makes the Sun appear to move across our sky.

sequence.title: Day and Night: 24-Hour Control Room
sequence.outcome: Explain day and night and the apparent movement of the Sun.
sequence.objective: I can use a rotating-Earth model to collect and explain evidence across one complete day-night cycle.

sequence.title: Spherical Bodies: Shape Evidence
sequence.outcome: Describe the Sun, Earth and Moon as approximately spherical bodies.
sequence.objective: I can use observations from different viewpoints to describe the Sun, Earth and Moon as approximately spherical bodies.

sequence.title: Spherical Bodies: World Shape Lab
sequence.outcome: Describe the Sun, Earth and Moon as approximately spherical bodies.
sequence.objective: I can collect fair comparison observations and combine them with real space evidence to describe the Sun, Earth and Moon as approximately spherical.

sequence.title: Solar System Research: Evidence Desk
sequence.outcome: Research and present findings about the Solar System using ICT.
sequence.objective: I can research one Solar System focus using suitable sources, accurate notes and a clear source record.

sequence.title: Solar System Presentation: Mission Briefing
sequence.outcome: Research and present findings about the Solar System using ICT.
sequence.objective: I can present researched Solar System findings clearly, credit sources and respond to an audience question with a change or a clear reason plus one transfer step.

sequence.title: Climate Chain: From Gas to Warming
sequence.outcome: Describe causes and effects of global warming and how to reduce our impact.
sequence.objective: I can explain how extra greenhouse gases raise Earth's average temperature and connect warming to wider climate effects.

sequence.title: Climate Action: Plan, Measure, Improve
sequence.outcome: Describe causes and effects of global warming and how to reduce our impact.
sequence.objective: I can explain how an action reduces climate impact, distinguish reducing causes from coping with effects, and plan evidence to check whether it worked.

sequence.title: Science Connections: Evidence Control
sequence.outcome: Consolidate forces, space and climate; answer scientific questions.
sequence.objective: I can connect a scientific question to the right idea and use evidence to explain my answer.

sequence.title: Answer Lab: Say It, Support It, Improve It
sequence.outcome: Consolidate forces, space and climate; answer scientific questions.
sequence.objective: I can give a scientific answer with evidence and reasoning, then improve it after audience response.

sequence.title: Rover Rescue: Plan a Fair Test
sequence.outcome: Consolidate and revisit key ideas through investigation.
sequence.objective: I can plan a fair investigation of how surface type affects a rover's travel distance.

sequence.title: Rover Evidence Lab
sequence.outcome: Consolidate and revisit key ideas through investigation.
sequence.objective: I can carry out a comparative fair test, use repeated distance results for a conclusion and improve the method.
